paper.title_en: From Critical Zero Modes to Interior Dynamics in Holographic Superconductors
paper.abstract_en: We study how the critical behavior of holographic superconductors controls the interior geometry of charged black holes. Although the exterior condensate vanishes at criticality, the critical zero mode develops logarithmic oscillations near the Reissner--Nordström Cauchy horizon, rendering the interior critical limit nonuniform. We show that the transmitted critical-mode amplitude, together with local Cauchy-horizon quantities, fixes both the leading Einstein--Rosen collapse $Δz_{\rm ER}$ width and the phase $Θ_J$ in the subsequent Josephson regime. If the condensate obeys $t\equiv1-T/T_c\proptoε^{2r}$, then $Δz_{\rm ER}\propto t^{1/r}$ and $Θ_J\propto t^{-1/r}$. This Josephson phase is transferred to the first Kasner epoch, producing oscillatory Kasner exponents and an accumulation law $t_n\sim n^{-r}$ for successive zeros of the scalar velocity. The critical zero mode fixes the leading collapse and phase coefficients, which are quantitatively confirmed by fully nonlinear solutions in both the ordinary and tricritical cases. At low temperature, the interior instead depends on the infrared completion of the zero-temperature geometry. Thus near-critical scaling is governed by critical-mode transmission, whereas the low-temperature behavior is controlled by the infrared endpoint.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将全息超导体的临界行为与带电黑洞内部几何联系起来，理论深度突出，推导了临界零模透射、Einstein-Rosen塌缩宽度与Josephson相位的标度关系，并得到了完全非线性数值解的支持，对全息凝聚态与黑洞内部结构研究具有较高参考价值。
decision.title_zh: 从临界零模到全息超导体中的内部动力学
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究全息超导体的临界行为如何控制带电黑洞的内部几何。尽管外部凝聚在临界点消失，临界零模在Reissner--Nordström柯西视界附近产生对数振荡，使得内部临界极限是非均匀的。我们表明，透射的临界模振幅，连同局部柯西视界量，决定了主导的Einstein--Rosen塌缩宽度$\Delta z_{\rm ER}$以及随后Josephson区域中的相位$\Theta_J$。如果凝聚满足$t\equiv1-T/T_c\propto\varepsilon^{2r}$，那么$\Delta z_{\rm ER}\propto t^{1/r}$且$\Theta_J\propto t^{-1/r}$。这个Josephson相位被传递到第一个Kasner历元，产生振荡的Kasner指数以及标量速度相继零点的一个积累律$t_n\sim n^{-r}$。临界零模确定了主导塌缩和相位系数，这些系数在普通和三临界两种情形下都由完全非线性解定量证实。在低温下，内部反而依赖于零温几何的红外完成。因此，近临界标度由临界模透射支配，而低温行为由红外端点控制。
